title: Dagobah
tagline: Credit-default swap for client, storage provider and risk taker in Filecoin.
description:
We build a fully decentralized protocol that leverages the power of FVM to make data storage more accessible and secure for both providers and consumers. 

Our protocol, inspired by the concept of Credit Default Swaps, enables storage providers to raise funds without the need for large collateral, reducing the barriers to entry in the market and ensuring reliability for data consumers.
how_its_made:
For our smart contracts, we use Solidity with Openzepplin contract and bootstrap using the FVM Hardhat template

And for our front we use Next.js to create the interface
We use useDapp when interacting with chains and Zondax to look at FVM storage deals.

We also use some CSS libraries such as chakra ui, etc.
